nodeProof.scope: Isolated Node WebAssembly execution of custom single-threaded, all60JPEGs libjxl JPEG reconstruction wrapper. Not browser/fullJSON/HTML integration.

completeContainerScreen.scope: Isolated complete FIDNUM02 JPEG-reconstruction frame. Exact custom single-threaded WASM inverse in Node; no production or browser adoption.
limits: Research frame parser is not production-hardened.
No browser/HTML startup or integration savings claim.
Decoder costs include glue and WASM but exclude integration code and transport overhead.
All original JPEG bytes reconstructed; no pixel re-encoding.

frame: FIDJXL01 + uint32 original size + uint32 untouched FIDNUM02-prefix size + untouched prefix + uint32 asset count. Each asset has uint32 UTF8 prefix length/prefix, one type byte, uint32 original payload length, uint32 stored payload length, payload. Type1 is byte-reconstructable JXL; type0 unchanged. Original asset order, prefix spelling, numeric lexemes, JSON whitespace and all other payloads restore exactly. This research parser still needs strict production bounds/overflow/count/checksum validation.
